milestone: M2 compiler-aware recovery through M0 evaluation
status: Automatic source-inductive entry predicates extend the selected development loop from three to four lanes. Fresh paired M0 gates pass; ordinary CLI/API policy remains unchanged.
findings: Infer modular index and unit-step trip-bound predicates from retained source SSA. Intervals and lane hints propose facts; only the two source-bound UNSAT queries establish the entry certificate.
Base induction checks actual function entry to the first header. Feedback induction checks the original source from the header to its next visit, preserving all RAM, normal returns and first faults.

The independent checker binds pure normalizers, source projections, markers and observations. The normalizer is the identity on every state satisfying its fixed-point equations; checking its entire image is a conservative superset.
A slice-local SSA identity matches the peeled lane index with its copied break-path value while keeping separate captured loads distinct.

Keep the already verified base recovery. Try a larger group under a bounded shared deadline; failed entry proofs and extension proofs retain the base and record their phase separately from C selection.
The selected full four-lane IR carries entry, completion, local correspondence, whole-function frame and original ABI namespace evidence through C generation.
